svg.title: ID cards: print, reprint, revoke
svg.desc: Pick one person, several people or a whole section, open the preview and choose a printer. Cards are split into batches of at most 200. Print a batch and confirm it: if all are fine you are done, otherwise reprint only the ones that failed. Every copy has its own QR. Printing again makes the next copy with a new QR. Revoking copy N makes only its QR show revoked; the other copies stay valid.
